messages.subject: For Toshiaki Tokunaga | Digital infrastructure, energy and government stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Hitachi Press Office,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Toshiaki Tokunaga, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Hitachi's portfolio across digital infrastructure, energy, rail and industrial transformation operates across complex government, regulatory and stakeholder environments. That intersection closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate cross-functional execution across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, infrastructure stakeholder strategy and emerging-market execution might support Hitachi's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Hitachi Ltd.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
